policy.title: Qvrix Privacy Policy
policy.intro: We, Eldar Memetov, operating under the trade name Qvrix (hereinafter referred to as the 'Controller'), respect your privacy and process personal data exclusively in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection laws. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, for what purposes, on which legal basis, and how you can exercise your rights.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.description: The controller within the meaning of Article 4(7) GDPR is:
points: Eldar Memetov (Qvrix — Video and Web for Business)
Hauptlehrer-Urson-Straße 9, 65439 Flörsheim am Main, Germany
Email: qvrix.studio@gmail.com
Website: https://qvrix.com

sections.title: 2. General Principles of Processing
points: We process personal data only to the extent necessary to provide a functional website and our services.
Processing is carried out in accordance with Article 6(1) GDPR.
We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and Server Log Files
sections.description: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., USA. Vercel acts as a data processor pursuant to Article 28 GDPR.
points: The following data may be processed automatically: IP address, browser type, operating system, date and time of access, referrer URL, and technical device information.
Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Data transfers to the United States are based on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: 4. Contact Form
sections.description: We use the server infrastructure of Render.com, Inc. to process contact form requests.
points: We process your name, email address, and message content.
The data is used solely to respond to your inquiry.
Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
The data is not used for advertising purposes and is not shared with third parties except for technical service providers.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and Local Storage
points: This website uses only technically necessary cookies and local storage.
We do not use Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Clarity, or any other tracking tools.
Legal basis: Section 25(2) TDDDG in conjunction with Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.title: 6. Fonts
points: Fonts are served locally using next/font.
Your IP address is not transmitted to Google or any other external font provider.

sections.title: 7. International Data Transfers
points: Due to the use of Vercel and Render, personal data may be processed in the United States.
Data transfers are based on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
points: Right of access (Article 15 GDPR).
Right to rectification (Article 16 GDPR).
Right to erasure (Article 17 GDPR).
Right to restriction of processing (Article 18 GDPR).
Right to data portability (Article 20 GDPR).
Right to object (Article 21 GDPR).
Right to withdraw consent at any time (Article 7(3) GDPR).

sections.title: 9. Right to Lodge a Complaint
points: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR.
Competent authority: The Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information.
Address: Gustav-Stresemann-Ring 1, 65189 Wiesbaden, Germany.
Website: https://datenschutz.hessen.de

sections.title: 10. Data Security
points: This website uses SSL/TLS encryption.
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures in accordance with Article 32 GDPR.
